body.message:
We completely understand your concern, especially regarding privacy in the evening, and we sincerely apologize for the confusion and inconvenience caused.

As you had requested an apartment in Building 18B, we arranged an apartment for you within the same building.

The apartment has been professionally designed and furnished as a complete concept, including the existing sheer curtains. Unfortunately, due to the current design and setup, we are unable to add or replace the curtains with blackout or additional privacy curtains.

We truly appreciate your patience and understanding, and we are sorry again for any inconvenience this may have caused during your stay.
